title: "The Biology of the Flying Saucer—II", The Aeroplane, 5 Mar 1948 (Figs. 8-10)
description: Magazine page from The Aeroplane (March 5, 1948, p. 279) with part II of A. R. Weyl's series on low-aspect-ratio aircraft. Line drawings include "Fig. 8.—Project by Warren and Young for a light twin-engined two-seater of 90 h.p. (1937)" in three views, "Fig. 9.—Model of the 'annular wing' of Antes, 1933", and "Fig. 10.—Principle of the Willoughby Delta design". Included as an inclosure to a US flying object report.
